Overview

Bodrum is a city in Muğla with a population of 175,000. A glamorous Aegean resort town, known for its whitewashed houses, Bodrum Castle, and vibrant nightlife. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 300 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.0.
